question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a red ball, Bob has a grey ball, Claire has a silver ball, Dave has a white ball, Eve has a teal ball, Fred has a orange ball, and Gertrude has a green ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Dave and Eve swap balls. Then, Alice and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Fred swap balls. Then, Fred and Eve swap balls. Then, Alice and Eve swap balls. Then, Dave and Fred swap balls. Finally, Dave and Gertrude swap balls. At the end of the game, Bob has the
Options:
(A) red ball
(B) grey ball
(C) silver ball
(D) white ball
(E) teal ball
(F) orange ball
(G) green ball
solution:
Each row lists ball colors in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: red, grey, silver, white, teal, orange, green
1. Dave–Eve: red, grey, silver, teal, white, orange, green
2. Alice–Gertrude: green, grey, silver, teal, white, orange, red
3. Gertrude–Fred: green, grey, silver, teal, white, red, orange
4. Fred–Eve: green, grey, silver, teal, red, white, orange
5. Alice–Eve: red, grey, silver, teal, green, white, orange
6. Dave–Fred: red, grey, silver, white, green, teal, orange
7. Dave–Gertrude: red, grey, silver, orange, green, teal, white
Bob has the grey ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
